## Tech Stack & Expertise
- **Frontend**: Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, GSAP, Lenis Smooth Scroll
- **3D & WebGL**: React Three Fiber (R3F), Three.js, GLSL Custom Shaders, Instanced Meshes, GLTF/GLB optimization
- **Backend & Cloud**: Cloudflare Workers (@opennextjs/cloudflare), Supabase (PostgreSQL, Realtime, Storage, RLS), Firebase
- **Design Systems**: Editorial Aesthetics, High-Performance Micro-interactions, Grid Governance

## Portfolio Projects
- **Honda Civic Key Visual**: Interactive 3D presentation and branding showcase for Honda.
- **MyBees (Ambev)**: Performance marketing campaigns and web applications for global beverage distribution platform.
- **Eudora**: Visual identity and high-impact digital campaign materials.
- **CBRE**: Digital experiences and brand collateral for commercial real estate leader.
- **Dolce Gusto**: Interactive campaign assets and digital media executions.
